boundaries: Exact uint4 equality and exact dictionary-index roundtrip; no semantic predicate reduction.
Measured seed 130; arbitrary input or arbitrary seed compression ratios are not guaranteed.
Entropy numbers are empirical independent-Bernoulli modeling estimates, not implemented encoding sizes or proven finite-fixture lower bounds.
Native index sizing assumes 1/2/4-byte integer indices.
TEX residency and performance have not been measured for any dictionary representation.

exact_fixture_structure.full_word_fringe_uniqueness_all_seeds: For any seed, distinct logical indices yield distinct full-width fringe words: multiplication by odd 0x9e3779b9, XOR with seed, mix32, addition 53, and mix32 are bijections of uint32. Every multiply inside mix32 is odd; xor-with-right-shift is invertible. Therefore full-width uint4 tuples are also distinct. The proof does not apply after a tail valid-bit mask truncates the word.
exact_fixture_structure.layout_effect: Linear and Morton8 only permute stored positions. They cannot change dictionary cardinality; run lengths may change.
exact_fixture_structure.padding_effect: Padding is initialized to the all-zero tuple. Tail words can repeat after valid-bit masking. Neither repetition applies to all-full-word unpadded main fixtures.
exact_fixture_structure.worst_case_joint_dictionary: For N stored tuples with no duplication, uint4 dictionary retains 16*N texture bytes and adds an index map. At the supported maximum N=262144, a uint32 map adds 1048576 bytes (25% overhead); an 18-bit packed map adds 589824 bytes but adds extraction complexity and no texture-byte saving.
exact_fixture_structure.entropy_caveat: The measured Bernoulli entropy estimate models masks as random bits with per-plane empirical probabilities. It is not a proven lower bound on these deterministic fixtures: seed and dimensions regenerate the masks. Replacing every texture fetch with procedural generation would stop testing a resident texture dictionary.
exact_fixture_structure.residency_caveat: A smaller dictionary is not proof of complete texture L1 residency. Index traffic, dependent texture fetches, dictionary alignment, sector utilization, cache mapping, and which dictionary entries each SM touches all require independent measurement.

decision: Reject joint-uint4 dictionary compression as a route to complete residency for full-width main fixtures. Boundary-only dictionary has a limited exact byte saving but needs separate TEX layout/index access and does not resolve full-workload retention.
